name: Abdullah Bin Murad (rifat)
bio:
Hi! I’m Abdullah, a PhD researcher in Chemical Engineering at Northeastern University, USA (fully funded). Before this, I completed my undergrad in Chemical Engineering at Shahjalal University of Science & Technology (SUST), Sylhet.

I know the journey to higher studies abroad can feel overwhelming—applications, research, funding, interviews—it’s a lot! Having gone through it myself, I can guide you step by step. From building a strong research profile during undergrad to securing a fully funded PhD spot, I’ve learned what works (and what doesn’t),

---

💡 What I can help with → Pathways to higher studies in the USA (and insights on other countries too) • Research guidance — how to start, where to look, and how to make it count • Application strategies to stand out for scholarships & funding • Honest, practical advice from someone who’s been in your shoes.

---

I’m here not just to answer questions, but to share my experiences so you can aim higher, avoid mistakes, and make your path smoother 🚀
